claims.span_literal: mNK cells comprised a distinct cluster marked by expression of FCGR3A, FGFBP2, KLRF1 and EOMES
claims.summary: Mature natural killer cells in white adipose tissue are marked by expression of FCGR3A, FGFBP2, KLRF1, and EOMES.

claims.span_literal: one cluster of NK-like cells discerned by expression of IL7R, SELL and CD2 similar to previously described CD56^(bright) immature NK (iNK) cells in human peripheral tissues18
claims.summary: Immature natural killer cells in white adipose tissue are discerned by expression of IL7R, SELL, and CD2.

claims.span_literal: a population of NK-like cells distinguished by expression of CXCR6, KLRC1 and GZMK consistent with tissue-resident NK (trNK) cells described in the human liver
claims.summary: Tissue-resident natural killer cells in white adipose tissue are distinguished by expression of CXCR6, KLRC1, and GZMK.

claims.span_literal: Four clusters did not express the NK cell-lineage-associated genes IRF8, EOMES, KLRF1, NCAM1 or PRF1.
claims.summary: Innate lymphoid cells in white adipose tissue do not express the natural killer cell-lineage-associated genes IRF8, EOMES, KLRF1, NCAM1, or PRF1.

claims.span_literal: these clusters could be distinguished from NK-lineage cells based on CD200R1 and IL7R coexpression
claims.summary: Innate lymphoid cells in white adipose tissue are distinguished from natural killer-lineage cells based on CD200R1 and IL7R coexpression.

claims.span_literal: WAT ILC clusters were defined based on differential expression of marker genes: GATA3 and IL1RL1 consistent with ILC2s described in mice and humans
claims.summary: Type 2 innate lymphoid cells in white adipose tissue are defined by expression of GATA3 and IL1RL1.

claims.span_literal: ZNF683 and TBX21 consistent with ILC1s described in mice
claims.summary: Type 1 innate lymphoid cells in white adipose tissue are defined by expression of ZNF683 and TBX21.

claims.span_literal: CCR6, IL1R1 and IL23R consistent with ILC3s described in mice and humans
claims.summary: Type 3 innate lymphoid cells in white adipose tissue are defined by expression of CCR6, IL1R1, and IL23R.

claims.span_literal: SELL and IL1R1 consistent with circulating ILC precursor cells (ILCPs) found in human blood
claims.summary: Innate lymphoid cell precursor cells in white adipose tissue are defined by expression of SELL and IL1R1.

claims.span_literal: CD200R1 expression could distinguish ILCs from mNK cells
claims.summary: CD200R1 expression distinguishes innate lymphoid cells from mature natural killer cells in white adipose tissue.

claims.span_literal: TBET^(hi)EOMES^(int)PERFORIN^(hi)CD16+ mNK cells
claims.summary: Mature natural killer cells in white adipose tissue are defined by TBET-positive and CD16-positive expression.

claims.span_literal: PERFORIN^(int)CD16^(-) trNK cells; and TBET^(lo)EOMES
claims.summary: Tissue-resident natural killer cells in white adipose tissue are defined by EOMES-high and PERFORIN-intermediate expression and are CD16-negative.

claims.span_literal: TBET^(lo)EOMES^(lo)PERFORIN^(int)CD16^(-)CD62L^(+/-) iNK cells
claims.summary: Immature natural killer cells in white adipose tissue are defined by TBET-low, EOMES-low, PERFORIN-intermediate expression and are CD16-negative.

claims.span_literal: mature CD200R1+ ILC populations did not express PERFORIN or EOMES
claims.summary: Mature CD200R1-positive innate lymphoid cell populations in white adipose tissue do not express PERFORIN or EOMES.

claims.span_literal: T-bet, IFN-g and IL-2 expression defined ILC1s
claims.summary: Type 1 innate lymphoid cells in white adipose tissue are defined by T-bet, interferon-gamma, and interleukin-2 expression.

claims.span_literal: CRTH2 and IL-13 expression defined ILC2s
claims.summary: Type 2 innate lymphoid cells in white adipose tissue are defined by CRTH2 and interleukin-13 expression.

claims.span_literal: NKp44, IL-1 receptor type 1 (IL-1R1), CCR6, RORC^(hi) and IL-17A expression defined ILC3s
claims.summary: Type 3 innate lymphoid cells in white adipose tissue are defined by NKp44, interleukin-1 receptor type 1, CCR6, RORC, and interleukin-17A expression.

claims.span_literal: CD62L, the lack of other mature ILC markers and the absence of cytokine production defined the ILCP-like population
claims.summary: The innate lymphoid cell precursor-like population in white adipose tissue is defined by CD62L expression.

claims.span_literal: Our analysis identified three populations of monocytes: ncMos based on expression of FCGR3A and HES4, Mo-1s by expression of FCER1A and Mo-2s via increased expression of CSF3R, FCAR and SELL, compared with Mo-1s
claims.summary: Nonclassical monocytes in white adipose tissue are identified based on expression of FCGR3A and HES4.

claims.span_literal: Our analysis identified three populations of monocytes: ncMos based on expression of FCGR3A and HES4, Mo-1s by expression of FCER1A and Mo-2s via increased expression of CSF3R, FCAR and SELL, compared with Mo-1s
claims.summary: Mo-1 classical monocytes in white adipose tissue are identified by expression of FCER1A.

claims.span_literal: Our analysis identified three populations of monocytes: ncMos based on expression of FCGR3A and HES4, Mo-1s by expression of FCER1A and Mo-2s via increased expression of CSF3R, FCAR and SELL, compared with Mo-1s
claims.summary: Mo-2 classical monocytes in white adipose tissue are identified by increased expression of CSF3R, FCAR, and SELL compared with Mo-1 classical monocytes.

claims.span_literal: a population of human WAT neutrophils based on expression of THBS1 and S100A12
claims.summary: Neutrophils in white adipose tissue are identified based on expression of THBS1 and S100A12.

claims.span_literal: TREM2, CD9 and LPL expressing lipid-associated macrophages (LAMs)8
claims.summary: Lipid-associated macrophages in white adipose tissue express TREM2, CD9, and LPL.

claims.span_literal: LYVE1, SELENOP and C1Q, expressing PVMs32
claims.summary: Perivascular macrophages in white adipose tissue express LYVE1, SELENOP, and C1Q.

claims.span_literal: an uncharacterized inflammatory macrophage (IM) population with high expression of CCL3L1, TNF and CXCL3
claims.summary: Inflammatory macrophages in white adipose tissue have high expression of CCL3L1, TNF, and CXCL3.

claims.span_literal: conventional type 1 DCs (cDC1s) defined by expression of IRF8, DPP4, CADM1 and XCR1
claims.summary: Conventional type 1 dendritic cells in white adipose tissue are defined by expression of IRF8, DPP4, CADM1, and XCR1.

claims.span_literal: coventional type 2 DCs subset A (cDC2As), via expression of CD1C, IRF4, IL7R and LAMP3
claims.summary: Conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset A in white adipose tissue is defined by expression of CD1C, IRF4, IL7R, and LAMP3.

terms.normalized_label: conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset A

claims.span_literal: conventional type 2 DCs subset B (cDC2Bs) by increased expression of CD1C, IRF4, FCER1A and CLEC10A
claims.summary: Conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset B in white adipose tissue is defined by increased expression of CD1C, IRF4, FCER1A, and CLEC10A.

terms.normalized_label: conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset B

claims.span_literal: WAT cDC1s were distinguished by expression of DPP4 (CD26) CD26+CD1C
claims.summary: Conventional type 1 dendritic cells in white adipose tissue are distinguished by expression of DPP4 (CD26) and are CD1C-negative.

claims.span_literal: cDC2Bs (CD26^(-)CD1C+CD206+CD14^(hi)FCER1A+CLEC10A
claims.summary: Conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset B in white adipose tissue is CD26-negative, CD1C-positive, CD206-positive, CD14-high, FCER1A-positive, and CLEC10A-positive.

terms.normalized_label: conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset B

claims.span_literal: FCER1A+CLEC10A+); cDC2As (CD26^(-)CD1C+CD206
claims.summary: Conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset A in white adipose tissue is CD26-negative, CD1C-positive, CD206-negative, FCER1A-negative, and CLEC10A-negative.

terms.normalized_label: conventional type 2 dendritic cell subset A

claims.span_literal: with expression of CD9 distinguishing CD206+CD11c+ LAMs, and CD206+CD11c^(-) distinguishing WAT PVMs as described previously
claims.summary: Lipid-associated macrophages in white adipose tissue are distinguished by expression of CD9, CD206, and CD11c, while perivascular macrophages are CD206-positive and CD11c-negative.

claims.span_literal: with expression of CD9 distinguishing CD206+CD11c+ LAMs, and CD206+CD11c^(-) distinguishing WAT PVMs as described previously
claims.summary: Perivascular macrophages in white adipose tissue are distinguished by CD206-positive and CD11c-negative expression.
